### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**2** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 70209b892a9baa5849cd887bf14107a28d668c7f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a91883cbbf0e83bb4feb6f0460582314d0cba15c` — the merge of head `e0c5c2fd6f7e43e12e7bb8055b5ec55a50b9db7c` into base `70209b892a9baa5849cd887bf14107a28d668c7f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a91883cbbf0e83bb4feb6f0460582314d0cba15c && git checkout a91883cbbf0e83bb4feb6f0460582314d0cba15c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 70209b892a9baa5849cd887bf14107a28d668c7f e0c5c2fd6f7e43e12e7bb8055b5ec55a50b9db7c && git checkout -B drift-repro 70209b892a9baa5849cd887bf14107a28d668c7f && git merge --no-ff e0c5c2fd6f7e43e12e7bb8055b5ec55a50b9db7c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 70209b892a9baa5849cd887bf14107a28d668c7f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e0c5c2fd6f7e43e12e7bb8055b5ec55a50b9db7c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts (the gate the new key trips, read as one change with it), and the cited code read on the head: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts (`RecordPathProps` L2054-2105 `strictObject`, `RecordChatterProps` L2032 and the `maxVisible` no-default precedent L1504), ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx (L133, L271-290, the readout with no handler), ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts (the reverse direction and the `carries no stale unpublished-key exemption` case, L1181-1260), packages/spec/liveness/field.json L97 (`stages[].terminal` / option `kind` precedent), packages/spec/liveness/object.json L60.

Inputs: card #28061 body and its three comments (claim 6526133189, claim correction 6526163273 with the seat's ruling A, os-dev-report 6527812635); PR #28198 body, 6-file list and the diff against `main` (+74/-0); the check-runs on `e0c5c2fd` (read 2026-10-30T17:11Z): 65 runs over 65 names, all `completed`, 58 `success`, 7 `skipped`, 0 `failure`; among the successes Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test UI, Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter, Test UI 1/16-16/16, Test Core 1/8-8/8. Author `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is owed. The reviewer is not the drafter (`session_01L9qibxNQzFQH8nBAaoSUkx`).

### ① Derived judgments

1. `RecordPathProps` (`component.zod.ts` L2054, a `strictObject` with `statusField`, `stages[]`, `aria`) gains one optional key `allowStageChange: z.boolean()` with no schema default. The accept set widens by exactly this key on `record:path` and nowhere else (`ComponentPropsMap['record:path']` is the only consumer of the schema); a non-boolean is refused at path `allowStageChange` with `invalid_type`; an existing path parses to an object equal to its input with no `allowStageChange` key written. **Right**, and the no-default choice is the file's own rule (`RecordChatterProps`, `maxVisible` L1504: a default turns "the author said nothing" into a declared value and inverts a renderer merge). Pinned by the three new `component.test.ts` cases (accept, no default written, refusal with code and path).
2. Generated surfaces: `authorable-surface/ui.json` adds `ui/RecordPathProps:allowStageChange`; `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` adds the row with the `.describe()` text. `check:generated` was 14/14 on the dev's merged head and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` runs it on this one. **Right.**
3. `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: one `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entry `record:path.allowStageChange`, with the measured reason (`record-path.tsx` draws a read-only rail and reads no such key, L271-290). Without it the reverse direction (`record:path publishes every top-level key its spec props schema declares`) reds Test UI, because `ui/` consumes this tree's spec through `workspace:^`; the dev's control run shows exactly that one failure. The entry is self-clearing: the file's `carries no stale unpublished-key exemption` case (L1181-1260) reports it STALE the moment the console registration publishes the input, so the console card must delete it in the same change. This is the file's own documented bar for an entry, and the seat's claim correction 6526163273 widened the file surface by exactly this entry. **Right.** No other `ui/**` path changes.
4. No liveness ledger carries component props (`packages/spec/liveness/` has no component ledger; the only `record:path` mentions are notes on `field.json` L97 and `object.json` L60), so no `planned` row is owed here, unlike a view or report key. The contract-first precedent on this same block is `stages[].terminal` / option `kind` (#23809, `field.json` L97: declared ahead of the renderer under the maintainer's ruling). **Right.**
5. No server change and no new refusal: the describe says the press writes `statusField` through the ordinary record update, so ADR-0020 `state_machine` validation and field edit rights judge it as any other edit. Nothing in the diff touches the engine, runtime or permissions, so the sentence is a description of the existing update path, not a new promise. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28061-record-path-allow-stage-change.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **minor**, one optional key on a published schema, nothing removed or tightened. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added (record:path allowStageChange)` sit line-initial on the PR body and the changeset. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared.
- Deviation 1 (file surface widened by one `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entry): answered in ①.3; reported before code and ruled A by the seat (6526163273).
- Deviation 2 (gates 60-106 re-run after a dts-less build overlapped): both sweeps exit 0; a reporting note, not a contract matter.
- Deviation 3 (`test:repo` not run locally): CI's Test Core, read above.
- `Skills-docs: none` with the reason (every taught `record:path` use stays true; the key is taught with the console half): accepted, the skill would otherwise teach a control that does nothing.
- Console follow-up (`domain:ui`: `record-path.tsx` honours the key, the registration publishes the input, the exemption entry is deleted, `pages.md` teaches it): the seat's card, as the PR body names it. The exemption's stale check is what makes landing the spec half alone sound.
- Serial constraint: open PR #28138 edits the same file far from `RecordPathProps` (claim 6526133189); no overlap in the hunks.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` against the card (#28061: an opt-in key on `RecordPathProps`, off by default, name for review; the console half to follow) and its first consumer:

- **The key holds against its consumer.** `record-path.tsx` (L271-290) registers `record:path`, reads `statusField` and `stages` off `ComponentPropsMap['record:path']`, and draws a readout with no handler; its channel (`useRecordContext`) exposes no field write. The console card is therefore a renderer change plus an input publication, with the spec row already typed `boolean | undefined`, which is the smallest contract that can carry the feature.
- **Name.** `allowStageChange` names the act the reader is allowed (changing the stage), matches the `allow*` opt-in spelling the component surface already uses, and does not collide with any key on `RecordPathProps` or the shared `AriaPropsSchema`. The card left the name for review; it is a sound choice.
- **Off unless authored, no default.** This keeps #11243's inert look for every existing page, and the no-default rule is the file's own (`RecordChatterProps`, `maxVisible`). Right.
- **Meaning is complete but not over-specified.** The describe fixes what the reader sees (pressable stages only for a reader who may edit `statusField`), the confirm, the write path (the `record:details` update with the concurrency token) and the refusal surface (in place). Each of those is a property of the existing update path, so the console half cannot honour the key in a way that bypasses `state_machine` validation without contradicting the spec. Right.
- **Strictness holds.** `RecordPathProps` stays a `strictObject`; an undeclared key is still refused, and the new key's refusal carries `invalid_type` at its own path (pinned).
- **Nothing is retroactive.** Existing pages carry no `allowStageChange`; their parse and drawing are byte-identical.

Should-fix (none blocks the contract):
- **S1** The describe text is a 70-word sentence that repeats the docblock; the reference table row (`component.mdx`) inherits it whole. A shorter describe (the opt-in and "off unless authored") with the behaviour kept in the docblock would read better in the generated reference; can ride the console card.
